definitions.explanation: Resting quietly to recover from illness or injury. A medical term commonly used by doctors when instructing patients to rest and avoid physical activity.

examples.japanese: {安静|あんせい}にして⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧{安静|あんせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧よう⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The doctor told me to rest for a week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{骨折|こっせつ}→骨折：02763_kossetsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧⟦{絶対|ぜったい}→絶対：00435_zettai⟧{安静|あんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Since I broke a bone, I was told that complete bed rest is necessary for a while.

notes:
USAGE:
Primarily a medical term. The most common pattern is {安静|あんせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to rest, to stay still). Doctors frequently use this when instructing patients after surgery, illness, or injury. ⟦{絶対|ぜったい}→絶対：00435_zettai⟧{安静|あんせい} (absolute rest / complete bed rest) is a stronger instruction meaning no movement at all.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {安静|あんせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to rest, to keep still
- ⟦{絶対|ぜったい}→絶対：00435_zettai⟧{安静|あんせい}: complete bed rest, absolute rest
- {安静|あんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧: rest is necessary
- {安静|あんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧: to maintain rest
- ⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧{安静|あんせい}: resting at home
